scalars.scalar_value: A minimum of 2 years of experience as a strength & conditioning coach at the collegiate or professional level of athletics.

The regular hours for this full-time position are at least 40 hours per week on a variable schedule. Weekend and evening work hours will be required. Travel may be required. Regular hours may vary due to needs of the College or division. Must be willing to work extensive weekend and evening hours.

items.item_text: Certification by the National Strength & Conditioning Association as a Certified Strength and Conditioning Specialist (CSCS), or by the Collegiate Strength and Conditioning Coaches Association (SCCC or Master SCC). Must be First-Aid/CPR/AED certified. A valid driver’s license is required or equivalent means of reliable transportation to off-site meetings and events.
Bachelor's degree in kinesiology, exercise science, physical education, health sciences, strength training, or related field plus.
A minimum of 2 years of experience as a strength & conditioning coach at the collegiate or professional level of athletics.

pay.source_text: regular, full-time, exempt position, benefits eligible. Annual Salary for this position is between $70,000 - $75,000 with a competitive benefits package. The specific factors that the College will consider when offer
